facts.fact: The March 2026 National Data Governance Policy lists the National Cybersecurity Strategy (2024-2029) among the policy instruments Liberia has adopted; no adoption date is given, so as_of is the document's published date (2026-03).

note: Liberia National CERT is only a policy prescription (to be established under the Cybercrime Act, which the document calls not yet enacted); no incident, CII designation or published figures stated.
